chapter: Childhood and community in the Seventh Ward
title: Non-musician family; first music, Wooden Joe at Burns Hall
summary: Bailey had no musicians in the family and never played, but loved music and dances. He remembers Wooden Joe playing Sunday parties at Burns Hall.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: And let's see, did you have any musicians in your family, Bailey?
Mm-hmm. And you never did play yourself?
Never did play. Used to go to dances.
Mm-hmm. Well now, what was the first music you remember or singing or anything as a kid?
Well, it was Wood and Joe. Used to play at the place of Burns Hall for parties on Sundays. Mm-hmm.
Would that be in the afternoon or night?
That'd be at night. Mm-hmm. From 8 till 8.
